fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Replication serializer bg3.exe+0x8EDB90 / write-all bg3.exe+0x8EDA90: dirty bit 1 -> bg3.exe+0x4017090 (EntityHandle writer) with *(DAT_146280598 /* zero-filled, so 0 */ + base) = offset 0. Toolkit esv::thrown::AttachmentSystem::ProcessAttachmentRequests copies the request's entity (+0) here when it adds the component; GatherRequests fills that entity from a queried component or an inventory member. Which entity (thrower / attach target) is not established.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Serializer: dirty bit 2 -> ScratchBuffer::Write(base + 8, 1 byte). ProcessAttachmentRequests sets it to (eoc::inventory::GetInventoryType(parent inventory of the entity) == 1). The client's ecl::thrown::DummyAttachmentComponent creator copies this byte (see layouts/equipment).

fields.name: field_9
fields.evidence: Serializer: dirty bit 4 -> Write(base + 9, 1 byte). Copied from request byte +8 (GatherRequests writes 1 there). macOS default constructor stores 0 at +9.

fields.name: field_A
fields.evidence: Serializer: dirty bit 8 -> Write(base + 0xA, 1 byte). Copied from request byte +9.

fields.name: field_C
fields.evidence: Serializer: dirty bit 0x10 -> ecs::sync::Serialize(writer, (FixedString *)(base + 0xC)). Copied from request +0xC, which GatherRequests fills with Empty or with the FixedString at +8 of a component looked up for the entity (FUN_180228f40 in the Toolkit).

open_questions: Meanings of every member are open (no FieldMeta names, no saved model; macOS names only the system's AttachRequest type, not its members): which entity +0 is, what the three flags at +8/+9/+A and the FixedString at +0xC mean.
+9/+A are typed bool by their 1-byte width only.
second_pass: Offsets and widths settled by the Windows write-all serializer bg3.exe+0x8EDA90: EntityHandle at +0 (DAT_146280598, zero-filled), 1-byte writes at +8, +9, +0xA and a FixedString at +0xC; size 16 matches the registry. Names stay unknown.
